title: Norway imposes near ban on AI in elementary school
summary: Norway has announced a near-complete ban on artificial intelligence in elementary schools, set to take effect in 2026, reflecting growing global concerns about AI's impact on children's development, privacy, and education quality.
problem_solved: Addresses concerns about potential negative effects of AI on young children's cognitive development, data privacy, and the integrity of early education.
why_valuable: This policy represents one of the world's strictest stances on AI in education, setting a precedent for other nations grappling with how to regulate emerging technology in schools.
